title: Tryouts and Recipe
author: U. M. Thackeray
blurb: Lior Kavanagh, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
